reason: The submitted CIFs are valid, fully occupied TlCNO realizations with the stated cell; the primary reduces to an 8-atom primitive Ima2 structure, has sensible O-C-N distances and periodic contacts, and its indexed positions and integrated intensities are strongly supported. However, all three submissions vary only the orientation ordering of the same O-C-N assignment. The trace never tests which light atom occupies the central 4d site. A concrete N-centered C-N-O realization can be instantiated in the same indexed cell with full TlCNO stoichiometry, no short-contact failure, and refined N-C/N-O distances of 1.238/1.247 angstrom. Against the blind pattern it remains comparably viable: its integrated-intensity R1 is 2.44% versus 1.63% for O-C-N, and an identically parameterized fixed-coordinate whole-profile fit gives 0.11315 versus 0.11275. This material element-ordering branch is absent from the submitted set and is not quantitatively rejected strongly enough to establish exact recovery.
